mapper.sql: version, status, source::text AS source, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions, chunk_count, relation_count, created_at, activated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_dataset WHERE version = #{version} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM knowledge_dataset ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT FROM knowledge_dataset WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT version FROM knowledge_dataset WHERE starts_with(version, #{prefix}) ORDER BY version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_dataset (version, status, source, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions, chunk_count, relation_count, created_at, activated_at) VALUES (#{row.version}, #{row.status}, #{row.source}::jsonb, #{row.embeddingModel}, #{row.embeddingDimensions}, #{row.chunkCount}, #{row.relationCount}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.activatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_dataset SET chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, relation_count = #{relationCount} WHERE version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (dataset_version, id, kind, subject, area, standard_code, domain_id, thinking_type, grades, semesters, notice_grade_band, text, record, embedding, content_hash, source) VALUES (#{row.datasetVersion}, #{row.id}, #{row.kind}, #{row.subject}, #{row.area}, #{row.standardCode}, #{row.domainId}, #{row.thinkingType}, #{row.grades}::smallint[], #{row.semesters}::varchar[], #{row.noticeGradeBand}, #{row.text}, #{row.record}::jsonb, #{row.embedding}::vector, #{row.contentHash}, #{row.source}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT id, kind, content_hash FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE dataset_version = #{version}
SELECT DISTINCT ON (content_hash) content_hash, embedding::text AS embedding FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE dataset_version = #{version} AND embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY content_hash, id
SELECT count(*) FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE dataset_version = #{version} AND embedding IS NULL
SELECT kind, count(*) AS count FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE dataset_version = #{version} GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_standard_semester (dataset_version, standard_code, semester, grade) VALUES (#{version}, #{row.standardCode}, #{row.semester}, #{row.grade})

choose.when: INSERT INTO knowledge_fits (dataset_version, standard_code, thinking_type, reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{version}, #{row.standardCode}, #{row.target}, #{row.reason}, #{row.reviewedBy}, #{row.reviewedAt})

INSERT INTO knowledge_prerequisite (dataset_version, standard_code, prerequisite_code, reason, reviewed_by, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{version}, #{row.standardCode}, #{row.target}, #{row.reason}, #{row.reviewedBy}, #{row.reviewedAt})
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO knowledge_covers (dataset_version, standard_code, content_id, reviewed_by, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{version}, #{row.standardCode}, #{row.target}, #{row.reviewedBy}, #{row.reviewedAt})

mapper.select: SELECT code, statement FROM achievement_standard WHERE code IN #{code}
